text: Which lawyers in Perth are best for TPD and superannuation insurance claims?

sections.text:
Several established Perth firms specialise in **TPD and superannuation insurance claims**:

- **Stephen Browne Lawyers** — focuses on superannuation and disability insurance claims, with offices in Perth and Joondalup.[4]
- **LHD Lawyers** — handles TPD superannuation claims and advertises no-win-no-fee arrangements; its Perth office is on St Georges Terrace.[2]
- **Maurice Blackburn** — offers TPD and superannuation insurance claim services in Perth, including no-win-no-fee representation.[9]
- **WKB Lawyers** — advises on superannuation claims, including TPD claims commonly subject to three- to six-month waiting periods.[7]
- **Turner Freeman** — has a Perth office and acts in personal injury and related insurance matters.[3]
- **Withstand Lawyers** — markets specialist TPD representation in Perth and offers an initial claim check.[6]
- **PK Simpson** — handles Perth TPD and superannuation claims, including claims arising after extended inability to work.[5]

There is no single “best” firm for every claim. When comparing lawyers, ask about:

- Their experience with your specific super fund and insurer
- Whether they regularly run disputed or rejected TPD claims
- The fee percentage, disbursements, GST, and any cancellation costs
- Whether the initial consultation is free and whether the matter is genuinely no-win-no-fee
- Who will personally manage the claim and how long similar matters usually take

For a straightforward claim, obtain **two or three free consultations** and compare the written costs agreements before signing. Check that the solicitor is admitted in Western Australia through the Legal Practice Board of WA.
